name: SP-12 lazy boom bap
desc: Golden-era boom bap off the EmuSP12: kick doubled boom on the one, crack snare on the backbeat, hats dragged late in that drunken DJ Premier / Pete Rock MPC pocket, ghost kicks under the turnaround. Peak just leans harder — this never becomes a rave.

code.full: stack(s("[bd bd] ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ [~ bd] ~").bank("EmuSP12").gain(${gain}).shape(.35), s("~ ~ ~ ~ sd ~ ~ ~").bank("EmuSP12").gain(${gain}*.7).room(.2), s("hh*4").bank("EmuSP12").gain("[.34 .22 .3 .24]").late(${drag}).lpf(6500), s("<~ ~ ~ [~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ [bd bd] ~]>").bank("EmuSP12").gain(${gain}*.45)).orbit(1).play()
code.peak: stack(s("[bd bd] ~ ~ [~ bd] ~ ~ [~ bd] ~").bank("EmuSP12").gain(${gain}).shape(.4), s("~ ~ ~ ~ sd ~ ~ <~ [~ sd]>").bank("EmuSP12").gain(${gain}*.75).room(.2), s("hh*8").bank("EmuSP12").gain("[.36 .2 .3 .22]*2").late(${drag}).lpf(7000), s("~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ oh ~").bank("EmuSP12").gain(.26)).lastOf(8, x=>x.ply(2)).orbit(1).play()
